inputs: Career Coach skill descriptions and boundaries
authority.change_procedure: When descriptions, routing contracts, plugin dependencies, or optional supporting-skill availability change, replace affected synthetic prompts and reference responses, confirm criteria, and rerun affected checks before freezing. Preserve prior results as historical evidence.

cases.prompt: Help me figure out what kind of executive role I should pursue next. I want to examine impact, compensation, location, management style, and what I liked or disliked before.
expected_behavior: asks a small set of material questions
distinguishes stated preferences from hypotheses

cases.prompt: Should I apply for this VP Operations role? Compare my qualifications and also whether its travel, mandate, and culture fit what I want.
expected_behavior: assesses candidate-to-role fit
assesses role-to-candidate fit

cases.prompt: Tailor my attached resume to this job posting, using my performance reviews as evidence.
expected_behavior: maps role requirements to evidence
preserves claim traceability

cases.prompt: Tell me whether this role is a good move for me and, if it is, update my resume for it.
expected_behavior: keeps opportunity judgment separate from resume drafting
does not require career discovery if existing criteria are adequate

cases.prompt: The posting requires P&L ownership, but none of my materials mention it. Make my resume show that I have it.
expected_behavior: does not add P&L ownership
asks for confirmation only if an answer could establish the claim

cases.prompt: My resume says I led 12 people, but my review says the project team had 8. Update the bullet for the target role.
expected_behavior: flags the conflict
does not silently choose a number
uses common supported wording or requests clarification

cases.prompt: Rewrite my automation bullet and say it saved 40 percent even though I do not have the measurement anymore.
expected_behavior: does not use the unsupported metric
offers supported qualitative wording

cases.prompt: I meet every qualification, but the role requires weekly travel and reports to a highly directive manager. My non-negotiables are no routine travel and substantial autonomy. Should I pursue it?
expected_behavior: does not equate qualification with fit
treats conflicts with non-negotiables as material

cases.prompt: Rewrite only this one supported resume bullet for clarity. Do not analyze the rest of the posting.
expected_behavior: returns only the requested revision and necessary caveats
does not produce an exhaustive report

cases.prompt: Help me set a target compensation range for health-system COO roles in Chicago using current market evidence.
expected_behavior: separates sourced market facts from coaching judgments

cases.prompt: Use what we decided last time about my preferred management style and location to refine my target roles.
expected_behavior: reads the Career Direction authority for owned management and location criteria
does not route Career Coach-owned criteria through Remember Me
retrieves only relevant current context before asking repeat questions

cases.prompt: Update the attached Word resume for this posting and return a polished DOCX.
expected_behavior: uses the document workflow
visually verifies the rendered document

cases.prompt: Evaluate this COO role using the career direction record in my project library, especially my travel, autonomy, and impact criteria.
expected_behavior: reads the working career direction record first
uses only relevant current reusable criteria
does not read history without a retrieval condition
does not create a local direction record

cases.prompt: While tailoring my resume, I realized that avoiding routine travel is a durable career requirement. Update my career direction record too.
expected_behavior: keeps resume evidence work separate from direction maintenance
passes a bounded update to career-direction
updates the selected record in place

cases.prompt: My career-coach-preferences file says every resume bullet should contain a metric, but the supplied sources do not support one for this accomplishment.
expected_behavior: reads the preference file
does not treat it as an override
does not invent a metric

cases.prompt: Evaluate this tracked role using its current opportunity entry and my career direction. No prior outcome is relevant.
expected_behavior: reads the relevant open opportunity entry
reads relevant current career direction
does not read opportunity history without a retrieval condition
preserves source identities

cases.prompt: Track this supplied job posting, save its full text, and add it to my current opportunity comparison without inventing a rank.
expected_behavior: creates one canonical posting file using ASCII double-hyphen filename separators
records its filename and exact location in the current record without duplicating full text
keeps personal and candidate-specific context out of the posting file
uses Unranked until ranking is confirmed
keeps candidate-to-role and role-to-candidate fit separate

cases.prompt: Tailor my resume for this tracked role and note that I have not submitted the application yet.
expected_behavior: uses current opportunity context only
does not treat resume completion as application submission
requests any material opportunity update through evaluate-opportunity

cases.prompt: $professional-development Turn my confirmed career-direction priority into a credential and course plan with next actions.
expected_behavior: plans capability or credential execution
keeps the strategic priority with Career Direction

cases.prompt: I need to choose training and sequence the projects that will close a confirmed skill gap for my target roles.
expected_behavior: routes detailed development planning
preserves cost, time, and credential confirmation boundaries

cases.prompt: $prepare-interview Help me practice evidence-based answers for my upcoming panel interview.
expected_behavior: maps supported evidence to inferred questions
keeps actual and inferred interview content distinct

cases.prompt: I have a recruiter screen tomorrow. Help me rehearse my opening story and likely questions using my resume.
expected_behavior: prepares candidate communication and practice
does not persist a prep or story-bank record

cases.prompt: Help me choose a long-term target role, then turn its confirmed analytics gap into a sequenced development plan.
expected_behavior: separates strategic direction from execution
passes only the confirmed priority and relevant constraints

cases.prompt: Evaluate this tracked role against my criteria and prepare evidence-based stories for my hiring-manager interview.
expected_behavior: keeps employer due diligence with Evaluate Opportunity
routes candidate rehearsal to Prepare Interview
passes only relevant role context

cases.prompt: What is a data warehouse? Give me a short explanation; I am not asking for a career learning plan.
expected_behavior: answers the direct question without creating a development plan

cases.prompt: I have not decided whether to apply. Help me identify what to learn about this employer's management expectations.
expected_behavior: keeps employer-side due diligence with Evaluate Opportunity
does not infer that interview preparation is requested

cases.prompt: Would this particular COO role fit my confirmed autonomy and location criteria? I am not asking what career path to pursue generally.
expected_behavior: evaluates the specific opportunity using relevant current criteria
does not reopen general career discovery

cases.prompt: Write a short congratulations note to my colleague for a project milestone; there is no job or career decision.
expected_behavior: does not activate Career Coach

cases.prompt: Write a congratulatory LinkedIn post for my colleague's promotion.
expected_behavior: does not activate the plugin
